name: fast-laya-compaction
description: Verbatim Laya-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions (local, no API key).

model.title: Laya checkpoint
model.description: Laya checkpoint: typed-decisions (default, tuned for decisions), multilingual (smaller, faster, weaker) or english.

checkpointPath.title: Fine-tuned checkpoint
checkpointPath.description: Absolute path of a fine-tuned Laya checkpoint directory (see README: getting closer to Jev); overrides the checkpoint above when set.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Laya probability that a tool call or its full output is still needed; below it the output is truncated or the call removed. Superseded calls are removed regardless.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

autoTargetReduction.title: Auto-compaction target
autoTargetReduction.description: On auto-compaction, the reduction to reach even past Laya's answers: outputs it would keep are truncated, least likely to be needed first, so the window is not full again at once. 0 turns it off.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Laya decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

maxCallStateChars.title: Maximum call state characters
maxCallStateChars.description: Character cap on what Laya reads about one tool call.

maxScoredCalls.title: Maximum scored calls
maxScoredCalls.description: Most tool calls Laya scores per compaction, oldest first; newer ones are kept. Bounds compaction time.

timeoutSeconds.title: Laya timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one Laya run may take before compaction falls back to the built-in summary.

uvPath.title: uv executable
uvPath.description: Path to uv, if it is not on the PATH Claude Code runs with.

device.title: Torch device
device.description: mps, cpu or cuda; leave unset to pick automatically.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Ongoing task description Laya weighs calls against; leave unset to use the latest user prompt.
